features.name: loan_to_income_ratio
features.description: Loan amount as a fraction of annual income, capped to avoid extreme outliers. Higher values indicate greater repayment burden.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth continuous severity measure useful for linear margin separation of risky vs safe loans.

features.name: log_income
features.description: Log-transformed personal income to compress heavy right tail and provide an approximately linear projection.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearizes skewed income distribution, improving SVM margin scaling.

features.name: log_loan_amount
features.description: Log-transformed loan amount to compress its right tail.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides smoother input scale for linear projections.

features.name: credit_score_normalized
features.description: Credit score scaled to [0,1] using observed range bounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized smooth severity score ideal for linear SVM weighting.

features.name: interest_rate_normalized
features.description: Interest rate scaled into approximate [0,1] using plausible bounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth continuous risk proxy; higher rates often correlate with risk.

features.name: previous_default_flag
features.description: Binary indicator of prior default presence on file.
features.expected_model_benefit: Strong linear-separable signal for repayment behavior.

features.name: employment_to_age_ratio
features.description: Employment experience as a fraction of adult years (age minus 18), capped at 1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth stability indicator; captures career maturity for linear separation.

features.name: credit_history_to_age_ratio
features.description: Credit history length divided by adult years, indicating financial track record depth.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth proxy for credit maturity, beneficial for linear margin.

features.name: interest_burden_weighted
features.description: Composite of loan-to-income times interest rate, approximating annual interest cost relative to income.
features.expected_model_benefit: Multiplicative risk composite useful as a linear margin feature.

features.name: renter_flag
features.description: Indicator that the borrower rents their home, a common risk-associated tenure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Discrete tenure signal contributing linearly to risk margin.

features.name: education_attainment_score
features.description: Ordinal mapping of education level reflecting attainment: High School=0.25, Associate=0.4, Bachelor=0.6, Master=0.8, Doctorate=1.0. Captures monotonic socioeconomic ordering.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous ordinal projection of education suitable for linear weighting.

features.name: loan_intent_risk_score
features.description: Semantic ordering of loan purpose by typical financial-stress association: DEBTCONSOLIDATION=0.9, MEDICAL=0.8, HOMEIMPROVEMENT=0.5, PERSONAL=0.5, EDUCATION=0.4, VENTURE=0.6. Reflects domain judgment about purpose-driven risk severity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes categorical intent as smooth continuous severity for linear SVM.
